metrics.name: median_scroll_and_time_by_page_version
metrics.pm_question: What is the median scroll_depth_pct and time_on_page_s by page_version? Does v4 drive deeper engagement than v3?
metrics.formula: quantileMerge(0.5)(scroll_median) and quantileMerge(0.5)(time_median) grouped by page_version

metrics.name: scroll_depth_threshold_to_application_conversion
metrics.pm_question: Is there a scroll-depth threshold above which application_started conversion is significantly higher?
metrics.formula: conversion = distinct users in 10_application_started / distinct users in landing_page_scrolled, bucketed by scroll_depth_pct band (e.g. 0-25,25-50,50-75,75-100)
metrics.note: Ambiguous + cross-spec; resolved via query-time join, NO MV (consistent with spec 08 conversion metrics).

metrics.name: paid_vs_organic_engagement
metrics.pm_question: Do paid users (gclid/fbclid) engage differently with the landing page compared to organic users?
metrics.formula: median/avg scroll_depth_pct and time_on_page_s grouped by is_paid (gclid!='' OR fbclid!='')
metrics.note: Engagement half MV-served. Conversion half is cross-spec query-time join to 10_application_started.

metrics.name: destinations_by_avg_scroll_depth
metrics.pm_question: Which destinations have the highest average scroll depth, suggesting strong content interest?
metrics.formula: avgMerge(scroll_avg) grouped by destination, ordered desc

metrics.name: mobile_vs_desktop_engagement
metrics.pm_question: Does mobile vs desktop show a meaningful difference in scroll depth or time-on-page?
metrics.formula: median/avg scroll_depth_pct and time_on_page_s grouped by device_type

deviations: D1: skip-indexed string/bool paths typed in payload(...); numeric metric paths untyped and minmax-indexed via CAST(...).
D2: agg TTL keyed on agg_insert_time DEFAULT now64(3), not event day.
